proposal.reason: Main change is CI execution correctness and reproducibility: `.github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml`, `source-sanity.yml`, and `pccl-daily-full.yml` now add authenticated registry pull, resolve paired `pccl-tests` branches with fallback, and pin dispatch builds/tests to label instants; this directly changes workflow run behavior, matrix reliability, and artifact/test identity. Supporting updates in `.github/xtest/run_cases.py`, `reconcile_results.py`, and `daily_reconcile.py` propagate `--pccl-tests-revision` through validation contracts, and `.github/workflows/scripts/pccl_for_test_hggcrt13_ubuntu24_build.sh` adjusts CI build pass ordering/env for the test row. These are CI orchestration/verification changes rather than contribution-policy (`workflow`) or product build-rule ownership.
